description: This file defines the FolderRepository class, providing CRUD operations and change stream notifications for folder data stored in a SQLite database, using the sqflite plugin. It manages folder creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and search functionalities, and emits change events for reactive UI components.

classes.name: FolderRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD and observation functionalities for Folder entities.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder record in the database.

methods.name: getFolderById
methods.description: Retrieves a folder by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFolders
methods.description: Fetches all folders ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing folder.

classes.name: FolderChange
classes.description: Represents a change event in the folder repository.

methods.name: FolderRepository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the change stream controller.
